# MinIO on Render

This repository runs a single-node [MinIO](https://min.io) server on Render with persistent SSD storage and managed TLS.

The Blueprint temporarily pins the MinIO server to a known-working image digest while the existing `/data` disk is recovered. MinIO stores its data on that persistent disk. Test any future image or user-ID migration separately before changing the production pin.

The Blueprint defines two web services:

* A public MinIO S3-compatible API server. Existing credentials are intentionally not managed or regenerated by the Blueprint; they remain in the existing service environment. For a new deployment, configure `MINIO_ROOT_USER` and `MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD` securely in Render before deploying.
* A separate Nginx proxy for the embedded MinIO web console. Use a dedicated MinIO console user where possible instead of the root credentials.

Automatic deployment is disabled for both services. Review the Render Blueprint preview before applying changes and abort if it proposes replacing an existing service or disk.
